titleTr: Yarın bu saatte: will be + V-ing

explainTr: Gelecekteki belirli bir anda devam etmekte olacak eylemi anlatır: will be + V-ing. This time tomorrow, I will be teaching fourth grade. (Yarın bu saatte dördüncü sınıfa ders veriyor olacağım.)

Başka bir kullanım, programda zaten yer alan işleri nazikçe sormaktır: Will you be using the copier? Bu soru 'Copier'ı kullanacak mısın?' diye zorlamaz, sadece planını sorar. Bu yüzden iş yerinde çok kibar durur.

Anlık karar ya da söz için future continuous değil, 'will' kullanılır: The phone is ringing. I'll get it. Durum fiilleri (know, want, have) continuous yapılmaz; onlar için düz will kullan: I will know the results on Friday.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Yarın bu saatte ders veriyor olacağım' tek bir ek zinciriyle söylenir (-iyor olacağım). İngilizcede ek yok; üç parça var: will + be + teaching.

reading.title: Hafsa's schedule for Monday
reading.text:
On Sunday evening, Hafsa sat at her kitchen table with her laptop and a cup of tea. Mr. Brown had just sent her the schedule for Monday, and she wanted to understand every line of it. She had never been responsible for an entire school day, so she read the email twice.

"At 7:45 a.m. you will be standing at the front entrance, welcoming students," it began. "From 8:15 to 11:30 you will be covering Ms. Carter's fourth-grade class. At 11:30 you will be supervising the cafeteria with Ms. Reed. After lunch, you will be taking the students to the library, and at 3:10 you will be helping with bus pickup." At the bottom, Mr. Brown had added a short note: "Please confirm that you are available."

Hafsa typed a quick reply, but then she stopped and looked at the ceiling. She imagined the next day. This time tomorrow, she would be standing in a noisy cafeteria, watching two hundred children eat sandwiches. At noon, she would be walking down the hallway with a list in her hand. She laughed at herself. A few weeks ago, she had been afraid to speak English on the phone.

Her neighbor Linda called a few minutes later. "Will you be working all day tomorrow?" Linda asked. "Yes, from morning until the buses leave," said Hafsa. "Then I will bring dinner at six," Linda said. "You will be exhausted, and you won't be cooking." Hafsa tried to refuse, but Linda would not listen.

Before bed, Hafsa packed her bag: a water bottle, a notebook, two pens, and a small bag of nuts. She set her alarm for 5:30. At the door she said quietly to herself, "Tomorrow at eight, I will be a real teacher for the day." She turned off the light. For the first time in weeks, she did not feel nervous. She felt ready.

writing.promptTr: Yarın bu saatte (ya da gelecek hafta) neler yapıyor olacağını anlat. Future continuous ile en az üç cümle kur ve bir arkadaşa kibar bir soru ekle.
writing.promptEn: Write a paragraph (120-180 words) about what you will be doing this time tomorrow or next week. Use the future continuous and add one polite question.
frames: This time tomorrow, I will be ...
At noon, I will be ...-ing, so please don't ...
By the evening, I will be ...
writing.model: This time tomorrow, I will be standing in front of a fourth-grade class at Lincoln Elementary. At eight o'clock I will be welcoming the students at the door, and at nine we will be reading a short story together. Around noon, I will be supervising the cafeteria with Ms. Reed, so please don't call me then. In the afternoon, I will be walking the children to the library, and I will be helping them choose a book. I think I will be feeling a little nervous at first, but I hope I will be smiling by lunchtime. Linda, will you be working from home tomorrow evening? If you are available, I would love to tell you about my day over tea. At six o'clock I will probably be cooking dinner for Emre, so you can join us. I hope the buses will be on time, and I hope the children will be happy.
checklistTr: En az üç cümlede will be + V-ing var mı?
Kibar bir 'Will you be ...-ing?' sorusu ekledin mi?
Durum fiillerini (know, want) continuous yapmadın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
